title: allocasuarina littoralis
intro: Allocasuarina littoralis, commonly known as Black Sheoak, is a species of flowering plant in the family Casuarinaceae. Native to southeastern Australia, it is a small to medium-sized tree with a slender profile, often growing near the coast. Research has identified several health benefits associated with Allocasuarina littoralis, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions such as reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of the plant, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
